content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fort Walton Beach

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Defense and aerospace professionals at firms like Lockheed Martin, L3Harris, and SAIC often meet these thresholds. Verify your specific credentials before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy delivers the required formal PMP education through live-virtual, instructor-led classes. Our nationwide online format lets Fort Walton Beach professionals learn on your schedule while staying current with project-management best practices and PMI standards.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Fee
steps_items.text: Once training is complete, submit your official application to PMI along with proof of education and experience. PMI reviews your credentials before approving you to sit for the exam. Processing typically takes one to two weeks.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources to help you review key concepts and practice questions. The PMP exam tests your mastery of project management across five domains. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner at your convenience.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you must earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep the credential active. PMI offers multiple pathways to earn PDUs—through training, volunteer work, or on-the-job project management—so you can grow professionally while maintaining certification.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
